claim_verdicts.evidence: Grafana docs (Data sources): "A data source in Grafana is a connection to a storage backend that holds your data, such as a Prometheus server"; Grafana "queries data sources to retrieve the stored data ... that it then visualizes in dashboards". Query docs: "Grafana panels communicate with data sources using queries, which retrieve data for the visualization." Scraping/storage by Prometheus: prometheus.yml@stage-2 scrape_configs job api.

Provisioning docs: Grafana reads provisioning files "when it starts up"; "When Grafana starts, it updates or creates all dashboards found in the configured path". docker-compose.yml@stage-2:269-270 mounts ./deploy/monitoring/grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro and ./deploy/monitoring/grafana/dashboards:/var/lib/grafana/dashboards:ro. Live Grafana 12.4.11: /api/datasources shows both data sources readOnly:true; /api/dashboards/uid/donhang-api meta provisioned:true, provisionedExternalId donhang-api.json.

git show stage-2:deploy/monitoring/grafana/provisioning/datasources/datasources.yml lines 1-12 match the block character for character; lines 14-20 add a second data source (name Loki, uid loki, url http://loki:3100). Live /api/datasources returns uid prometheus, access proxy, url http://prometheus:9090, isDefault true.

Provisioning docs, data source field access: "Sets the access mode, either proxy or direct (Server or Browser in the UI). Some data sources are incompatible with any setting but proxy (Server)." proxy = Server, i.e. the Grafana server makes the request.

dashboards.yml@stage-2: providers name donhang, folder Đơn Hàng, type file, allowUiUpdates false, options.path /var/lib/grafana/dashboards. Provisioning docs: with allowUiUpdates false "you can't save changes to a provisioned dashboard. When you try to save changes to a provisioned dashboard, Grafana brings up a Cannot save provisioned dashboard dialog box." Live /api/folders: folder Đơn Hàng managedBy classic-file-provisioning.

donhang-api.json@stage-2: four panels, all type timeseries; titles at lines 20/64/108/152 as quoted; expr at 56 = sum by (code) (rate(http_requests_received_total[5m])), 144 = histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]))). Block lines 49-59 match character for character.

Queries docs: "Grafana supports up to 26 queries per panel." "Queries and expressions are identified with a letter (A, B, C, and so on) by default." Prometheus query editor, Legend > Custom: "{{hostname}} is replaced with the value of the hostname label." Live GET /api/dashboards/uid/donhang-api: targets per panel [1,1,1,1]; target datasource.uid prometheus = datasources.yml uid.

Provisioning docs: updateIntervalSeconds = "how often Grafana will scan for changed dashboards"; "When updateIntervalSeconds is 10 or less, Grafana watches the filesystem", which may fail with Docker bind mounts, so "at the latest the next time Grafana starts" is the correct hedge. UI saves: "Grafana persists the changes to its database". compose@stage-2 grafana has no volume for /var/lib/grafana.

Opinion, now worded as round-1 suggested_text. Grafana dashboard best practices: RED = Rate, Errors, Duration, "most applicable to services"; RED dashboards are "a proxy for user experience"; "Dashboards should reduce cognitive load, not add to it." Lesson §4 and summary 5 say "common first set" and "rough picture", which the page supports.

docker-compose.yml@stage-2:264-272: GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD "${GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD}", ports "3000:3000". Live GET /api/search with admin + GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD from .env: folder "Đơn Hàng" (dash-folder) containing dash-db uid donhang-api title "Đơn Hàng API". /api/health version 12.4.11.

metrics-endpoint.sh@stage-2 runs curl http://localhost:8080/api/v1/products/999; executed GET on the running lab: 404. donhang-api.json:11 "refresh": "10s" (live dashboard refresh 10s). prometheus.yml@stage-2 scrape_interval: 5s. Panel 1 expr sum by (code) with legendFormat {{code}} yields a series labelled 404. Worst case ~5 s scrape + 10 s refresh, within half a minute.
